# Demo_Site

Website + Digital Growth Platform for Saudi/GCC SMBs.

## Product
- [README](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/README.md): product scope, truth rules and local test.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/AGENTS.md): operating and safety rules for coding agents.
- [Agent operating system](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/docs/AGENT_SYSTEM.md): role boundaries and development workflow.
- [Architecture audit](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/docs/REPOSITORY_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md): current repository findings and roadmap.
- [Open-source research](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/docs/OPEN_SOURCE_RESEARCH_2026-09-18.md): sourced research and adoption boundaries.
- [Data model](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/docs/DATA.md): additive Supabase growth data contract.
- [QA checklist](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/main/QA_CHECKLIST.md): validation requirements.

## Important
This repository is the application source. Do not infer a public production URL, rankings, customer data, traffic, or AI-model results from repository contents. Unknown or unavailable evidence must remain explicitly unknown/unavailable.
